thread: The Convocation patrol-budget session Sylvanas is dodging

evidence.clue: Convocation sits the next day at Sunfury Spire on the patrol budget; Sylvanas should attend in formal greens.
A magister's nephew has figures on why the southern posts need new bowstaves; magisters question what the Pass needs a full company for.
Lor'themar goes in her place and will say she was called off 'by something with teeth'.

Chapter 3 (Sylvanas's thoughts): the Convocation chamber in Sunfury Spire, 'the magister's nephew with his figures', Lor'themar on the bench 'being charming for her'; the chamber would hold a child's word 'up to the lamp. And the Ranger-General saw this herself?'; the dispatch will reach the Convocation 'by the end of the week' and the nephew will ask whether the Ranger-General had leave to send two rangers and their horses back to the Pass with a human child at the patrol's expense ('Let him count it. She had sixty in a cow way.').
Sylvanas judges her duty 'done, by any measure the chamber would put its seal to' once the dispatch is sent.

readerKnows: The Convocation will hear the Millhaven warning via Lor'themar; the cost of the courier is already a political objection in Sylvanas's mind.
notes: Silvermoon is still not shown directly. Lor'themar's reaction and the Convocation's are future consequences.
